author: Claude H-SU
what: physical split of ot_hgi_sfu_scheduled_engine into ot_hgi_sfu_programme_store (die slot sfus_<q> 1020x1412: io calendar + arithmetic calendar, 22 ot_sram_1r1w_1024x256, every pin registered) and ot_hgi_sfu_core_split (die slot sfucore_<q> 763.56x3001.91: VM bridge, 16 ot_su12_sfu lanes, 80 operand SRAMs; io word + 1742-bit control registered at its pins)
method: tools/hbm_static/run_sfu_split_equiv.sh, tb rtl/test/hbm_accel/generic/tb_hgi_sfu_split_equiv.sv: reference ot_hgi_sfu_scheduled_engine runs the canonical 3072-word Qswiglu closed-loop with real VM taps/banks (gold PASS); the split pair receives the same host cfg/start and the reference VM/gather returns delayed by 3 edges; every core output (local_rq/wq, vi_re/addr, ro_v/x, kv_we/waddr/wdata) must equal the reference delayed by 3 and every status output (programme/io active/done/ordinal) the reference delayed by 2, on every edge after reset

results.positive_R0: SFU_SPLIT_EQUIV PASS edges=6497 active_output_edges=6329 + canonical gold PASS 3072 words (reference ot_hgi_sfu_split_engine R0 u_core LG1)
results.positive_R23: SFU_SPLIT_EQUIV PASS edges=6681 active_output_edges=6513 + canonical gold PASS 3072 words (reference R23 u_core LG24)
results.mutant_flip: one compiler_control bit corrupted on the crossing -> REJECTED (first mismatch edge 6223)
results.mutant_skip: core input pin register removed -> REJECTED (first mismatch edge 5631)
results.superseded: first run at 0eba16957 (no core pin registers) PASS too; replaced by this run

latency: per SFU invocation: +3 stream edges (store in/out regs + core in reg, uniform shift) + 2 edges on the VM round trip (core pin-register pair = one LG unit) = ~+5 edges/record; qwen_ar ~+0.016 % (36 records), DS 0 %; no ledger row
not_claimed: die netlist binding (H-NETLIST adds sfus_<q> programme store)
pin_registers: ot_hgi_sfu_core_split registers local_rq/local_wq/ro_v/ro_x (out) and local_rr/local_w_done (in); the bridge runs LG_PATH+1 (die LG_PATH 24 = 1 leaf + R23 -> bridge 25, IO calendar SFU_LG_PATH 25); vi_*/kv_* stay register-to-register lane <-> sfustore (closed lane n+3 gather latency), parent feedthrough
